asr.full_text: Electric activity within the heart determines heart rate. If this electrical activity is delayed, a slow heart rhythm may occur. People with slow heart rate. A pacemaker is composed of two parts, a pulse generator and a wire or lead. The lead is passed through a vein and makes contact with the heart muscle. The pulse generator constantly with the heart muscle. The pulse generator constantly monitor the heart rate. When it detects that the heart rate falls below a certain level it sends the lead down the impulse to the heart which causes it to beat. A small surgery is required to implant a pacemaker which takes about an hour. Patients are awake during the procedure and are given the mild sedative. The area under the collarbone is frozen and a small incision is made. The lead is then passed through through the vein to the right side of the heart using X-ray guidance. The pulse generator is then connected to the lead and the incision is closed. Patients will usually go home the next day. Pacemaker surgery is safe. That way, I can be sure that the patient is recovered and does not have to take a physical examination or hospitalization. Pacemaker surgery is safe. The most common risks are bruising, bleeding, or pain around the incision. Other risks include infection or a pacemaker lead moving requiring another procedure to reposition it. After your operation, you will be given instructions on how to care for your incision and will be given an appointment to come back to the pacemaker clinic in a few days You may not drive for one week and should not live your arm on the pacemaker side above the shoulder for one month. If you have questions, speak to your doctor or call the pacemaker clinic.
